theme_strategy.rationale: Nature, Health, and Service businesses relate best to Light themes for trustworthiness, cleanliness, and clarity. A toggle for Dark mode should be available in the dashboard, but Light is the primary focus.

rules: Headings (>32px) MUST use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Overlines/Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny (text-xs) + tracking-[0.2em].
Line Height: tight (leading-none) for headers, loose (leading-relaxed) for body.
Never use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato for headings.
No default SaaS Blue. Use the defined deep forest green (Moss/Sage) as the primary brand color.
Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Blacks and grays must be tinted with warmth to match the earthy palette.
Limit the use of the primary color to main CTAs (buttons, primary forms).

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle grain/noise overlays (opacity-5) to kill digital flatness on marketing pages.
visual_enhancers.borders: Dashboard cards use 1px solid border-border/40. No heavy drop shadows by default.
surfaces: Headers/Nav: Use Glassmorphism (bg-white/70, backdrop-blur-xl, border-b border-black/5).
Dashboard Cards: Flat Solid off-white, 1px subtle border, rounded-2xl.
Modals/Dialogs: Glassmorphism overlay with solid white card.

grids_and_layouts.marketing_pages: Bento Grid (Mode A). Asymmetry, gap-8 to gap-12. Never fill 100% of the grid perfectly.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-4 or gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for breathing room.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align paragraphs, inputs, and dense content.

motion.interactions: Hover states must explicitly set text color (e.g., hover:bg-primary-hover hover:text-white).
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (transition-transform, transition-colors). NEVER use 'transition: all'.
motion.animations: Framer motion for staggered list entrances and subtle page transitions.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text. Use APCA guidelines. Focus states must have HIGHER contrast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').

image_urls.description: Empty barber shop with sleek chairs and illuminated mirrors. Use for Salon/Beauty industry section.
Spacious and stylish hair salon interior. Use for landing page hero or features.
A bright, clean dental clinic. Use for Medical/Clinic industry section.
Tidy desk setup with tablet calendar. Use for Booking/Calendar feature highlight.

strategy: Use purely HTML/Tailwind for Marketing page layouts (raw div, section, span) to allow overlapping.
Use Shadcn components for complex logic (Forms, Modals, Calendars, Selects) heavily customized to match the Organics & Earthy brand.

3d_libraries.steps: Install framer-motion via yarn. Wrap page transitions in motion.div. Use staggerChildren for lists.
3d_libraries.rationale: For a SaaS booking app, a full 3D canvas (R3F) is overkill and detracts from utility. Use Framer Motion for premium 2D page transitions, modal scale-ins, and bento grid item staggers to keep the UI ultra-fast and lightweight.

instructions_to_main_agent: Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...).
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...}).
DO NOT center align the app container. DO NOT add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky/floating elements.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or rounded-xl) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in headers, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
Use standard JS/JSX files (.js), no TypeScript (.tsx).
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Components MUST use named exports. Pages MUST use default exports.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js
